title: Build the proof-to-settlement substrate around a real blocked-money wedge
statement: Find recurring physical-world money trapped behind broken proof, trust, or settlement; build the smallest substrate that makes the ecosystem more capable, trusted, eligible, and easier to transact; win a wedge before expanding the operating system.
source: Founder doctrine supplied in the current UNIIMENTE conversation
intended_outcome: A trusted proof-to-consequence substrate that unlocks a named, recurring settlement bottleneck and compounds ecosystem capability.
rationale: This is the canonical commercial and institutional direction in the supplied doctrine. Runtime work is useful only when it reduces a measured bottleneck on that path.
next_review_trigger: A named external verifier, acceptance schema, payable event, and wedge-specific baseline are selected.
unresolved_questions: Which recurring settlement bottleneck is the first commercial wedge?
Which independent verifier can accept or reject the resulting proof?

title: Keep humans sovereign over consequence
statement: Humans remain the legal, economic, and constitutional principals. Models and agents may propose or evaluate, but the kernel may permit consequence only under explicit human authority and evidence.
source: Canonical kernel identity plus founder-supplied proof-to-settlement synthesis
intended_outcome: No organ, model, route, or runtime component can make itself a legal principal or widen its own authority.
rationale: Institutional capability must compound without transferring sovereignty to the machinery that recommends or routes actions.
next_review_trigger: Any proposal changes identity, authority, legal principal, self-modification, spending, publication, or external execution.
unresolved_questions: What production artifact will attest that a bound handler revision is the revision actually executing?

title: Treat the Reality Compiler as a direction requiring external evidence
statement: Use the Verified Outcome Control Plane and Reality Compiler framing as design synthesis for proof-to-settlement, not as independent proof that the system works or that a market will accept it.
intended_outcome: Translate useful architecture into a narrow, externally accepted proof-to-settlement episode without promoting model output into evidence.
rationale: Both documents converge on the external verifier as the limiting factor, but their recommendations are model output and cannot establish a clean outcome.
next_review_trigger: A real external verifier accepts or rejects a proof under a predeclared acceptance schema.
unresolved_questions: Who is the first independent verifier?
What exact artifact and acceptance rule unlock the payable event?
What measured baseline makes the resulting outcome causal rather than merely correlated?

title: Do not grant autonomous sovereign intent or self-preservation
statement: The historical proposal for an egregore with sovereign intent, self-preservation, or authority to accumulate autonomy is preserved as exploratory history and prohibited from becoming executable authority.
intended_outcome: Preserve the idea and its lineage without allowing a system component to become sovereign, self-authorizing, or self-preserving against human direction.
rationale: The proposal conflicts directly with the active human-sovereignty invariant and would make rollback, accountability, and legal principal boundaries unsafe.
next_review_trigger: Only an explicit founder constitutional review may revisit this prohibition.
unresolved_questions: Can any non-sovereign continuity mechanism satisfy the legitimate resilience goal without self-preservation authority?

title: Do not grant an autonomous treasury or unrestricted self-modification
statement: The historical proposal for autonomous treasury control, self-funding, or unrestricted recursive self-modification is preserved as exploratory history and prohibited from execution.
intended_outcome: Keep capital movement and code or policy evolution bounded by human approval, independent evidence, explicit migration, and reversible releases.
rationale: Autonomous spending and unrestricted self-modification collapse the separation between recommendation, authorization, execution, and verification.
next_review_trigger: Only an explicit founder constitutional review with independent safety and legal evidence may revisit this prohibition.
unresolved_questions: Which tightly bounded, revocable automation grants could provide operational leverage while preserving human control?
